caption:
Birmingham's tap water comes from Wales 💧
It starts in the Elan Valley reservoirs in mid Wales and travels 73 miles (118 km) through a Victorian aqueduct, with no pumps: it runs on gravity alone, dropping just 52 m on the way and taking about 3 days. Opened in 1904 and still flowing today. Severn Trent describes the water from Wales as moderately soft.

Where does your water come from? Comment your town 👇
Sources: Severn Trent, Elan Valley Trust, Institution of Civil Engineers
